_comment: Vertical is configuration, not code. Swapping this file retargets Otto at another phone-priced market without touching agent logic.

price_unit.name: out-the-door total
price_unit.definition: Everything the buyer pays to drive away: vehicle price + all dealer fees + tax + title + registration. The single number every conversation must resolve to.
price_unit.why: Listing price is not comparable across dealers because fee structures differ. OTD is the only figure that makes two quotes the same kind of thing.

pay_without_argument.reason: Government charges, identical at every dealer in the state. Arguing here spends credibility that is needed elsewhere.

negotiate.reason: Dealer-retained charges that are conventional but not fixed. Either removed directly or offset against the vehicle price.

items.name: documentation fee
items.note: California caps this at $85. A California dealer quoting more than $85 is misstating the cap.

items.name: dealer prep / reconditioning
items.note: Work done before the buyer existed; it belongs in the retail asking price. Charging it separately on top of full retail is double-dipping.

refuse_outright.reason: Dealer-installed profit items the buyer never requested. Add-on bundles have averaged roughly $2,000 per vehicle in recent transaction data, so this line is often the entire negotiation.

items.name: VIN etching
items.note: DIY kit is $20-30; anti-theft benefit is minimal

red_flags.rule: quoted OTD is 30% or more below comparable market
red_flags.why: A quote far below the market is a warning, not a win. It usually means undisclosed damage, a branded title, or fees that appear later.

red_flags.rule: title is salvage, rebuilt, lemon buyback, or otherwise branded
dealer will not allow an independent pre-purchase inspection
red_flags.why: Disqualifying, full stop. There is no good reason to refuse an inspection on a sound car.

red_flags.rule: dealer will not give an out-the-door number by phone
red_flags.why: A store that will not quote OTD is planning to add something later.

red_flags.rule: price is contingent on dealer financing or a bundled product
red_flags.why: Signals rate markup ahead; the advertised price is not the real price.

red_flags.rule: dealer steers to monthly payment instead of total
red_flags.why: The four-square is coming. Payment framing hides the total.

red_flags.rule: deposit required to hold the vehicle or honour a price

negotiation_levers.use: A car sitting 60+ days is under real cost pressure — dealers borrow to buy inventory and pay interest daily. Car-specific rather than dealer-specific, so it works even at a no-haggle store.
A real, itemised OTD from another dealer on a comparable vehicle. Only ever a quote actually captured on a call.
negotiation_levers.constraint: Never invented, never estimated, never averaged. If no competitor gave a comparable number, this lever does not exist.

negotiation_levers.use: Refuse dealer-installed extras outright, or demand the equivalent off the vehicle price.
When a fee is claimed to be mandatory: 'Then take the equivalent off the vehicle price and we are at the same place.'
If they already cut the price once, the floor is lower than the current ask.
Mileage above average for the year, or reconditioning items disclosed on the call.
Volume targets are live in the last three business days of a month or quarter.
Pre-approval removes rate markup, but cash is weaker leverage than buyers assume — dealers earn on financing. Mention payment method last, never first.

concession_ladder._note: 10-12% below their quoted OTD is aggressive but inside the normal band for used inventory.
rules: Never make two consecutive concessions without a counter from them.
Trade concessions, never gift them: every move up buys the removal of a fee or an add-on.
Go silent after stating an offer. Do not fill the pause, do not add a softener.

escalate_to_human: dealer requests any personal identifier, credit authorisation, or payment
deposit required to hold the vehicle or honour a price
title is branded, salvage, rebuilt, or a lemon buyback
dealer refuses an independent pre-purchase inspection
undisclosed structural or frame damage appears
quote is contingent on financing terms, a warranty, or a bundled product
dealer becomes hostile or objects to negotiating with an AI
anything is asked that is not in the buyer spec
the written quote does not match what was agreed verbally

benchmarks.note: Comparable live listings matter more than the estimate. Establish the spread before any call.

jurisdiction.notes: California is an all-party consent state: if the call is recorded, the agent must ask and receive a yes. California's bot-disclosure law requires disclosure where an automated system is used to influence a commercial transaction.
